block.comment: Concession Stand script is a proof of concet and is entirely experimental. It works using a hack on the clone implementaion, which itself is already experimental in nature. When the parallel-for-each block is collapsed to hide the "parallel workers" input, it operates in serial mode and no clones should be spawned. When parallel workers is enabled, one clone per array element should be spawned. Don't let the array size get very big - this feature hasn't been tested beyond getting this particular demo to work. Note: the only difference between the for-each and the parallel-for-each blocks is the hidden "parallel workers" input which is indicated by a right arrow on the far right of the for-each block. I didn't take the time to figure out how to hide the right arrow once the workers input is opened up, so clicking right arrow to open more inputs will have null effect as only the first workers input is actually read.
